# feat: add Radar & Trend views to dashboard

## Pull Request by @polykrate

## Summary

Switches the dashboard submodule to [polykrate/jam-conformance-dashboard](https://github.com/polykrate/jam-conformance-dashboard/tree/feat/dual-source-radar-trend) which adds the following features:

- **Data source selector** (Parity / FluffyLabs) — single site displays both datasets, Parity data loaded statically, FluffyLabs fetched at runtime
- **Radar view** — 16-axis chart (4 traces × 4 weighted metrics: P50, P90, Mean, P99) with:
  - Gold (1×) and silver (2×) threshold circles
  - Full speed / Half speed team filtering
  - Cross-source comparison overlay (solid vs dashed polygons)
  - Fuzzy team name matching across sources
  - Adaptive scaling (auto-linear for close teams, log for wide spread)
- **Trend view** — historical performance chart (FluffyLabs only, uses `history.json`)
- **FluffyLabs baseline rebased to spacejam** — `relativeToBaseline` recalculated client-side since per-trace data has no `score` field

### Screenshots

The Radar and Trend tabs appear alongside the existing Overview and individual trace tabs.

## Changes

- `.gitmodules`: dashboard URL → `polykrate/jam-conformance-dashboard`
- `dashboard` submodule commit updated to include all new components

### New files in dashboard fork
- `src/components/STFRadarChart.tsx` — radar visualization
- `src/components/PerformanceTrend.tsx` — trend visualization
- `src/components/DataSourceSelector.tsx` — source toggle
- `src/lib/use-data-source.ts` — dual-source data hook with spacejam rebase

### Modified files in dashboard fork
- `src/app/page.tsx` — routing for radar/trend views + data source integration
- `src/components/BenchmarkTabs.tsx` — radar & trend tabs
- `src/config/performance.ts` — speed thresholds
- `src/app/layout.tsx` — suppressHydrationWarning

## Test plan

- [ ] Select Parity source → verify Overview, Radar work with davxy data
- [ ] Select FluffyLabs source → verify Overview, Radar, Trend work with remote data
- [ ] Radar: click Full speed → should show spacejam (1.0×) + faster teams
- [ ] Radar: click "Compare sources" → overlay same team from other platform
- [ ] Trend: verify historical chart loads for FluffyLabs
- [ ] Verify no console errors beyond expected HMR/hydration warnings
